title: Polynomial-Time Unary Addition
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ assign natural numbers to bit strings. If the functions sending $x$ to the unary strings of $f(x)$ ones and of $g(x)$ ones are polynomial-time computable, then the function sending $x$ to the unary string of $f(x)+g(x)$ ones is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: Functions $f,g$ from bit strings to natural numbers.
The unary encoding of $f(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
The unary encoding of $g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
